requirements.requirement: The system must include a field named 'enrollment_status_score' in each clinical trial object returned by the evaluate_care_facade.
The system must populate 'enrollment_status_score' using the value computed by clinical_trials_service without recalculation in the facade.
The system must preserve all existing clinical trial response fields unchanged when adding the enrollment_status_score field.
The system must return enrollment_status_score as a numeric value conforming to the schema defined in EVAL-CT-STATUS-001.
The system must include enrollment_status_score for every clinical trial in the response when the upstream scoring logic provides a value.
The system must not omit or rename existing top-level response keys in the evaluate_care_facade output.
The system must ensure the response structure remains backward compatible with existing chat layer consumers.
The system must include enrollment_status_score in all code paths where clinical trials are returned by evaluate_care_facade.
The system must set enrollment_status_score to null when the upstream scoring logic returns no value for a trial.
The system must not throw an error if enrollment_status_score is missing from the service response and must still return the clinical trial payload.
The system must propagate multiple clinical trial records each with their own enrollment_status_score without aggregation at the facade layer.
The system must ensure that adding enrollment_status_score does not increase response latency beyond existing facade thresholds.
